messages.body: Ran /sc:implement on the amended plan: 14 of 14 tasks have a complete ledger line (T4, T5, T6, T10 and T12 needed fix passes; T10 went through the retry ladder), FINAL review passed and the package is archived at .dev/tasks/done/TASK-WF-spec-20261108-181616/; the variant is built on the 472-line Arm B base plus a '## Activation' heading you approved (481 lines), and INSTALL.md lists every file with its ~/.claude destination. Results: new tests '92 passed in 14.18s'; spec-panel/routing/install keep-green set '1483 passed in 7.53s'; make lint 'Errors: 0' and ruff 'All checks passed!'; wider suite '1 failed, 3364 passed, 2 skipped', the one failure being tests/unit/test_ccsession_tiers.py (a model-alias shim port clash, a file this branch never touches; it passed 3 of 3 re-runs). Not built or not verified: the grader, canaries and PASS-time audit were never run against a live model (only the script is tested); the control-r1 replay gives 8 anchored / 0 late-found, not the SPEC's predicted 5/3; protocol slips you should know: I saved adviser A's T10 answer before adviser B returned, and my helper deleted T10's sweep ref, which I re-pinned to the attempt-2 checkpoint tree (refs/superclaude/implement/TASK-WF-spec-20261108-181616/retry/T10/sweep-2-1; remove with git update-ref -d when no longer needed); nothing is committed.
